_comment: Photoionization sensitivity with the other feedback loops at fixed values.
gamma0 = 1E-2 is the ion-induced secondary-emission yield (gamma1 defaults
to 0, so gamma+ = gamma0 exactly).  xi_emit = 1 is the default photoemission
multiplier; the photon-induced yield is 0.1 * xi_emit in this mechanism.
Detachment (O2- + O2, O- + N2) is left at its default rate.  xi_photo scales
the photoionization coupling from 1E-2 to 1E2 times the default.
